items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I remember that session because Junior was one of the guys... I think on that record my brilliant idea was to have him play a blues on a harpsichord?

ctx.x: Junior Mance. It’s “Darling Je Vous Aime Beaucoup,” but he calls it “Harlem Lullaby.” Yeah.
“Harlem Lullaby.” And I just thought this song had something, I just loved it. I didn’t know who Junior Mance was.
